Stone has successfully drilled and completed for production the MC 109 A28ST1.  The well was spud on 12-23-10, by cutting a window in the 9 5/8" @ 4101' MD / 3573' TVD. The well was drilled to a total depth of on 01-24-11, 14890' MD / 9594' TVD, w/a MW of 12.1 SBM.

A 5" prod. liner was set from 12220' MD to TD,14880' MD and the well completed for production.  The well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion in the "M" Sd with perforations of 14438' - 14557' MD.  Operations were completed on the well on 02-25-11.

30" DP was cut 17' BML on 3/9/2011.  20" csg was cut 17' BML on 3/8/2011.  Stone Energy was unable to pull the 30" DP x 20" csg at this time.  They will be pulled when the associated EI243 D-AUX structure is removed.  13-3/8" casing cut 18' BML on 3/8/2011.

36" csg cut @ 20' BML on 4/7/2011.  16" csg cut @ 20' BML on 4/6/2011.  36" x 16" csg not pulled at this time, will be pulled at time of platform removal.  10-3/4" csg cut & pulled @ 25' BML on 4/6/2011.  All csg cut via mechanical means.

Stone has successfully completed zone chane operations on the SS 198 G-13ST well to produce the "LN" sand. The previous completion, the "LO" sand, was isolated by setting a CIBP at 11,890' MD and dumping 52' of cement on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 11,838' MD. The "LN" sand was perforated at intervals 11,786'-11,790' & 11,808'-11,820' MD. Operations began on 09/25/2010 and ended on 04/17/2011.
triples: 52' of cement on top of the plug

Stone has successfully plugged back and prepared for sidetrack operations the MC 109 A06 well using the H&P 206 platform rig unit.

The current completion interval for the well, the ""J" Sand perforations, 9438' - 9532' MD  was isolated by setting a cement retainer @ 9300 and squeezing the perfs with cement, leaving ETOC in the 7" csg @ 9300'.  A 300' cement plug in the 7" csg was set from 9300' - 9000' MD.  

The 7" prod. csg was cut & pulled at 2500' MD.   A cmt retainer was set in the 7" csg @ 2450' MD & 225 sxs of cmt sqz'd below the retainer.  50' of cmt was dumped on top of the retainer @ 2450', ETOC @ 2400'.  The 9 5/8" csg was perforated, 2030' - 2033' MD.   A EZSV set at 2000' and 300 sxs of cmt squeezed below the retainer.

Operations began on 07-20-11 and were completed on 08-16-11.

Rooster Petroleum has successfully completed permanent abandonment operations of the VR 175 A01 well.  The current completion interval in the well, the"P" sand existing perforations, 5831' - 5433' were previous sqz'd with cmt on 07-13-04, leaving ETOC in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5330' MD.  A TTCIBP was set in the 2 7/8" prod. tbg @ 5275' and 20' of cmt dumped on top, ETOC @ 5255' MD.  The 2 7/8" prod. tbg was perforated @ 2050' MD & a 329' cmt plug set in the 
2 7/8" prod. tbg & 7 5/8" csg, 2050' - 1721' MD.  The cmt plug was tested to 1000 psi & tagged @ 1687' MD.  

2 7/8" prod. tbg was cut & pulled @ 517'.  The 7 5/8" csg was cut & pulled @ 477' MD.  A CIBP was set in the 10 3/4" csg @ 474' MD & 206' cmt plug set in the 10 3/4" csg, 474' - 268 MD. The cmt plug was tagged @ 268'.

10 3/4" csg was cut & pulled @ 227' MD (37' BML) and the 24" drive pipe was cut & pulled @ 219' MD (25' BML).

Operations began on 08-09-11 and were concluded on 08-17-11.  Note, 48" well support caisson will be cut & removed at a later date when the structure is removed.

Production tubing was cut and pulled from 9430'RKB 08/08/11. Production packer set @ 9380'RKB 08/09/11. New tubing with GLMs and SCSSV was run 08/10/11 - 08/11/11. Current wellbore schematic is attached.

Stone has successfully drilling and completed for the production the SS 117 #4ST well.  The well was spud on 03-05-12 by cutting a window in the 9 5/8" csg @ 4916' MD and drilled to a TD on 03-21-12 at a depth of 10827' MD / 10290' TVD.  MW at TD was 12.5 ppg OBM.

7" production csg was set at TD and the well completed as single non-gravel packed gas completion in the "C9/10 Lwr" Sd, with perforations of 10712' - 10785' MD.

Well was batch set (through the 22" casing) and suspended on 05/08/2012, pending further operations.
On 05/31/2012, tagged cement @ 8,698'. Apply 20k weight test down. Displaced well to 12.2 ppg mud with corrosion inhibitor. Install 30" TA Cap and inject McDermid fluid in TA Cap.

Coiled tubing operations were successfully completed on the VK 990 Well A-28ST to clean out the wellbore and isolate the "M83C" Sand existing perfortions of 15,992'-16,072' MD due to lower GP screen failure. The "M83C" Sand perforations were isolated by setting a NVTTBP at 15,727' MD and dumping 17' of cmt on top of the plug, w/ ETOC at 15,710' MD. Operations started 11-16-2012 and ended 12-18-2012.

Wellbore was sidetrack to a depth of 13,869' MD/ 12,372' TVD, no hydrocarbons were encountered.  A cement retainer was set at 8,850' MD / 7,659' TVD and a surface plug was set from 352 - 575' MD.  An APM will be submitted to perform permanent abandonment operations at a later date.

Well was spud on March 11, 2013 and TD reached on March 29, 2013 with a depth of 11,194' MD/10,950' TD.  Well was completed as a single, gravel packed oil completion  in the B-22 and completed as a single, gravel packed alternate completion in B-23 Sand. Operations were completed on May 13, 2013.

Operations were successfully completed for Zone Change to Q-Sand. Operations commenced on 03/30/2013 and was
completed 04/07/2013. R-Sand was isolated by setting a TTVBP @ 16,525'MD and dumping 52'cmt, ETOC=16,473'MD. Pressure tested cmt plug @ 16,473'MD to 1000psi. Fish stuck in hole @ 16,440'WLM. The Q-Sand was open to production by perforating intervals, 16,300'-16,340'MD.

The 20" and 30" casing strings were cut at 15'BML.  In the process of recovering the casing, they became stuck in the damaged platform trying to pull to the surface.  Conductors will be pulled when platform is removed.

The subject well was drilled to 11,150' MD / 10,696' TVD. A 7", 26.0 ppf,HCP-110, Ultra SF production liner was ran and cemented from 7,910' - 11,150'. Top of cement is at the liner top based on cement being reverse out after the liner cement job and CBL. Plugged cased-hole MDT 3/16" hole exist in the Bul 1-6 Sand at 10,995' and an unplugged 3/16" hole exist at 10,975'.

Completed as a single oil well with a FP completion in the Bul 1-6 Sand from 10,950' - 11,006' in 7' casing.

Rooster Petroleum, LLC has successfully completed TA operations of the HI A-494 Well C-1 (ST01). 

Summary of Operations:

TT-CIBP in 3-1/2" tbg @ 6900' RKB + 51' cmt (TOC @ 6849' RKB); pressure tested to 1000 psi

Perf'd 3-1/2" tbg @ 6800' RKB; M&P 10.6 bbls (55 sxs) Class H cmt for 375' balanced cmt plug in 3-1/2" tbg & 3-1/2" x 7" annulus f/ 6425'-6800' RKB; pressure tested to 1000 psi

Cut/pulled 3-1/2" tbg f/ 775' RKB (476' BML)

Cut/pulled 7" csg f/ 750' RKB (451' BML)

CIBP in 10-3/4" csg @ 669' RKB (370' BML) + 50' cmt (TOC @ 619' RKB (320' BML); pressure tested to 1000 psi

M&P 19.25 bbls (100 sxs) CLass H cmt for 203' bal cmt plug in 10-3/4" csg f/ 396'-599' RKB (97'-300' BML)

Cut/pulled 10-3/4" csg f/ 334' RKB (35' BML)

Operations commenced 11/05/2016 and were completed 11/12/2016.

Rooster Petroleum, LLC has successfully completed TA operations of the VR 376 A-2 Well. The 2-7/8" LS tbg was cut/pulled f/ 1,000' BML (1,392' RKB) & the 2-7/8" SS tbg was cut/pulled f/ 990' BML (1,382' RKB). 

Operations began 06/04/2017 and were completed 06/18/2017.

Note: All casings cut in 2003 by Kerr McGee.  The 20" x 24" casing was hung off and pinned @ +20.  The 9-5/8" is @ 45' AML, the 13-3/8" @ 46' AML and the 24" is at 54' AML. The status was changed to TA and this EOR is for the removal of the 20" x 24" at the +20.

The A-12D well was shut in on 08/24/2017 due to Hurricane Harvey. In order to remain in compliance with CFR 250.829(a)(1) the PB valve assembly was pulled and a DS pump through style plug was set in the S-Nipple at 5774' MD.

Operation Completed 12/13/2017

Stone has successfully completed workover operations of the EI 49, OCS-G 17959, Well No. 03 to install a through tubing sand control assy. and return the well to production. CT ops to complete the work were started on 12-12-06 and completed on 12-21-06.   The production tbg was punched 7743' - 7749' and a MRBP set at 7789'. Then a through tubing Gravel pack assy. was set from 7666' - 7789'. See attached Current Wellbore Schematic for details on changes to the downhole wellbore profile.

Remington has drilled the EC 316 OCS-G 23803, Well No. 01 to a TD of 3600' MD /TVD, w/a MW of 10.2 ppg.  The wellbore was TD'd on 04-22-07.  7 5/8" 29.7#/ft, ECP-110 production csg has been set at 3565' MD /TVD.  Remington has performed Inital Completion Opertations of the EC 316 Well No. #001 as a  sub sea (mud line tree installed, single, GP, gas completion in the 3300' Sd.

HIA572 Well No. C022 was temporarily abandoned on 05/27/07 with casings to be cut and pulled a minimum of 15' BML at time of platform removal.  Due to well bubbling, Apache requested approval to drill out existing cement plug/retainer and squeeze cement to stop bubbling.  Well C022 bubbling has been corrected and remains in TA status.

The ST 86 OCS-00605, Well E-5 was spud on August 27, 2007 and TD'd on September 16, 2007 at depth of 4289' MD / 4113' TVD. The well was completed for production as a single,gravel packed, oil completion in the 3700' Sand with existing perforations of 4084' - 4134' MD. Completion operations began on September 25, 2007 and completed on October 01, 2007.

Stone has successfully performed zone change operations on the WC 56 OCS 00301, Well No. 16 to produce the Discorbis "B-1" Sd.  Operations began on February 24, 2008 and were completed on March 2, 2008.  The previous producing interval in the well, the Discorbis "B-2" Sand was isolated by setting a TTVP @ 9110' and dumping 20' cement on top, ETOC @ 9090'.  The Discorbis "B-1" Sand was perforated @ 9006' - 9016'.
